name: Terrain SDF Collision Detection and Resolution
definition: A collision detection and resolution step for terrain using Signed Distance Fields (SDF). It detects if an object moved from outside to inside or vice versa between two time steps and estimates the surface normal to resolve the collision.
summary: Terrain SDF Collision Detection and Resolution identifies collisions via distance sign changes and estimates surface normals to resolve penetration, distinguishing itself by explicitly handling resolution rather than just reporting intersections.
